payload.contract_notes: Single-token MLA decode: q[B,H,latent_dim+rope_dim], new_kv[B,latent_dim+rope_dim], a resident native KV cache, and lengths[B] produce latent attention output[B,H,latent_dim] and updated_cache. Lengths count valid tokens after append; append at lengths-1 before attending. Empty requests produce zero output and do not append. The final latent-to-value projection is excluded. For paged caches, only valid token/feature positions are guaranteed; future slots and padding are unspecified, and historical KV values must be finite. Tensor shapes, layouts and numerical settings are specified per config. Historical project2 runs are imported_unverified.
